Specification: This specification models a very small evidence-handling scenario in which the single state variable msgs is a set of message-like records with fields src and r. The initial condition restricts msgs to be a subset of a record type over Proc and Rounds, and additionally requires every message currently in msgs to have round field 2. The next-state relation introduces a LET-bound set Y collecting the src fields of messages in msgs, requires msgs to be nonempty, and leaves msgs unchanged; the comments indicate these ingredients together capture a subtle bug scenario rather than a full protocol with liveness or fairness properties.
